method.speed: vitest bench, per-query mean ± sd; rel = time relative to krino (100%), lower is faster
method.quality: time-boxed median per cell, median across N fresh processes; MRR@10 over the scored probes
method.memory: heapUsed + external delta across building one searcher, in a fresh process per cell, median of 3; typed arrays are external, so heapUsed alone would undercount

corpora.ascii: en faker locale — effectively no diacritics
corpora.mixed: mostly en with fr/pl every 7th item — ~5% of items carry a diacritic
